Biweekly National Respiratory Virus Sentinel Surveillance Report for week 33 & 34 (Aug 10—23, 2025)
• Flu activity decreased in weeks 33 and 34, with positivity rates of 15.4% (10 cases) and 28.8% (19 cases), respectively. COVID-19 positivity was recorded at 15.38% (10 cases) in
week 33 and 7.57% (7 cases) in week 34. No RSV-positive cases were detected during these weeks (Figure 1).
• A total of 131 samples were tested for influenza, SARS-CoV-2, and RSV using real-time RT-PCR. These included 104 ILI cases, 11 SARI cases, 8 eSARI samples, and 8 outbreak-
related samples (Table 1 & 2). All sentinel sites reported ILI cases in both weeks; however, SARI data were not reported by Trashigang Hospital (week 34) and Samdrup Jongkhar
Hospital (week 33) (Figure 3, Tables 3 & 4).
